mapper.sql: select id, device_id, name, parent_id, parent_device_id, create_time, update_time from qs_common_region
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO qs_common_region (device_id, name, parent_id, parent_device_id, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{deviceId}, #{name}, #{parentId}, #{parentDeviceId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE qs_common_region SET update_time = #{updateTime}, device_id = #{deviceId}, name = #{name}, parent_id = #{parentId}, parent_device_id = #{parentDeviceId} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT id, id AS tree_id, longitude AS longitude, latitude AS latitude, device_name AS name, device_status AS status, type, flv_type FROM qs_device WHERE
( gb_civil_code IS NOT NULL AND TRIM( gb_civil_code ) != '' )
AND ( ( ( longitude IS NOT NULL AND TRIM( longitude ) != '' ) OR ( latitude IS NOT NULL AND TRIM( latitude ) != '' ) ) )
